_readme: Features of the coin platform (Palmyra Launch) that the coins channel announces, in English only, no promise of any return. src/lib/coinsChannel.ts turns each entry into a post (once the platform is live). scripts/promo/supervise.mjs reports any public page in public/zenobia/ that is neither listed under `pages` nor under `exempt`: add an entry here when a new page or feature ships.

features.title: Explore coins like a trading terminal
features.text: Trending, new, closest to graduation, top and graduated lists, 24h top movers and a watchlist, all on one screen. Experimental platform with unaudited contracts: only use what you can afford to lose.

features.title: Every coin page: candles, curve and a Trust check
features.text: Price candles, the bonding-curve map, a Trust check, the holders list and sticky Buy and Sell buttons. The Trust check helps you look closer; it is not a guarantee of safety.

features.title: Swap tokens inside Palmyra Launch
features.text: Swap on STON.fi without leaving the app. The quote shows the DEX pool fee plus our 0.30% platform fee before your wallet signs, and unverified tokens are clearly marked. Not financial advice.

features.title: Journey: streaks, quests and ranks
features.text: Check in daily, finish quests and climb from Traveler to Queen of the desert. Points are only a progress score kept on your device: not money, not a token, and nothing is promised for them.

features.title: Coin alerts from the bot
features.text: Open a coin from the Palmyra Launch bot and turn on alerts: the bot messages you when it gets close to graduation, graduates to DeDust, or its price moves 20%. Not financial advice.

features.title: Vote on coins: ⭐ 🔥 💔
features.text: Quick community votes on every coin page. They show sentiment, not safety or price, so always read the Trust check yourself.

features.title: Your portfolio in one place
features.text: See the coins you hold with an estimated value at the current curve price and sell from the same screen. Creators also see the earnings from the coins they launched.
